Birla Fertility & IVFThe category today · the rules

On 6 October, the rules changed.

We plan inside them from day one. Your legal team signs the final checklist.

RuleWhat it means on social
NMC public notice, 6 October 2026No testimonials or patient success stories, no “best” or guaranteed outcomes, no AI-made patients, no pay linked to referrals.
ASCIIVF success-rate and “best” claims have been upheld as misleading. Creators giving health advice state their qualifications.
ART Act, Surrogacy Act, PCPNDT ActNothing that suggests sex selection or commercial surrogacy, on any channel.
Drugs and Magic Remedies Act, 1954Its schedule lists sterility in women, so no line reads as a cure or remedy claim.
DPDP Act and Meta ad policyExplicit consent before patient data touches marketing. Ads never imply a viewer’s health.
Sources: NMC notice as reported by The South First and BestMediaInfo; ASCI; India Code; Meta. Full list at the end.07 / 26

Birla Fertility & IVFHow it runs · the sensitivity code

Eight rules we sign in week one.

01

Every claim is checked

Medical lines come from a named specialist and pass medical review before anything posts.

02

Hope, told honestly

No guarantees, no success-rate headlines, no “best”, no miracle words.

03

Both partners, always

We name factors and never blame a partner. Men’s fertility gets equal airtime.

04

Every path counts

Content speaks to people still trying, freezing eggs, or still deciding.

05

Testimonials stay out

No patient success stories or testimonials, in line with the October 2026 NMC notice.

06

Hard days, planned for

Mother’s Day, baby showers and festive “good news” moments get a quieter calendar.

07

Real, calm imagery

Real rooms, real hands, warm light. No AI-made patients, voices or before-and-after images.

08

Words that comfort

We retire “failed”, “barren” and “infertile woman”, and write the way a good counsellor talks.

A draft for your medical, legal and counselling teams to edit and sign.18 / 26

Birla Fertility & IVFAppendix · sources

Sources.

The numbers

About 17.5% of adults, roughly 1 in 6, experience infertility in their lifetime: World Health Organization, 2023. Male factors in 40 to 50% of cases in India: Indian Society of Assisted Reproduction, via BioSpectrum India. Over 90% of people facing fertility problems feel emotionally exhausted and 29% seek timely help: Birla Fertility & IVF study, released with Fertility Circle, June 2025 (MediaBrief). About 200,000 to 250,000 IVF cycles a year in India, expected to reach 400,000 by 2030: Business Standard, June 2025.

Birla Fertility & IVF

50+ centres, 120+ experts and 1,40,000+ IVF cycles: @birlafertility on Instagram. 51 clinics in 38 cities across 18 states at the Jalandhar launch, 2025 (Medtech Spectrum). ARMC IVF, May 2024, and BabyScience, August 2024 (Venture Intelligence, BioSpectrum India). “All Heart. All Science.” (Digital Health News). Fertility Circle, 1800 123 1515, in English and Hindi (MediaBrief, June 2025). YouTube @birlafertilityivf, 470+ videos.

The category

Indira IVF: 165+ centres (Business Standard, July 2025), about 390K Instagram followers (public profile), Tumko Meri Kasam (ThePrint, 2025). Nova IVF Fertility creator series (Confluencr). Cloudnine Fertility, “Every Fertility Journey is Different”, World IVF Day 2026 (Business News This Week). Ferty9 #TogetherInIVF (MediaNews4U). Motherhood “I Am Very Fortunate” (Motherhood India).

The rules

NMC public notice of 6 October 2026, as reported by The South First and BestMediaInfo. ASCI Consumer Complaints Council releases, October 2019 and January 2020; ASCI guidelines for health and finance influencers, 2023. ART (Regulation) Act 2021, section 32; Surrogacy (Regulation) Act 2021, section 38; PCPNDT Act, section 22; Drugs and Magic Remedies Act 1954, schedule (India Code). DPDP Rules, November 2025. Meta advertising standards on personal attributes and family planning.

Care

Tele-MANAS, India’s national mental health helpline: 14416. Fertility Circle, Birla Fertility & IVF’s counselling line: 1800 123 1515.

The ideas

Idea names, formats, the content mix, service levels and the plan are Mask360’s proposal. The calendar assumes a start on Monday 16 November 2026.
